accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The results concern only rank of the fortified outcome-pairing route on positive factor tables; proxy validity, bridge existence, and the other proximal premises are not established.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Conditional on a valid-proxy causal extension and the remaining YuShiTchetgen2025 premises, the Hall certificate diagnoses Assumption-5 feasibility only; it neither identifies nor disproves identification of tau.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Give an explicit small structural-zero support and rational positive factor table attaining the asserted rank, including its Hall-deficient counterpart; this makes the stochastic-realization step independently auditable.

Prove an extension lemma showing exactly when a positive factor table admits a full causal model satisfying YuShiTchetgen2025 Definition 2.1, so the pairing frontier is tied directly to the intended proxy-validity regime.
Develop the uniform-versus-generic question into a decidable sufficient support class, such as triangular or subtraction-free minor supports, before attempting the full classification.
